jsonld_raw.name: TWO OF ME BOOK (ENGLISH)
jsonld_raw.description:
This posthumous book collects the most intimate memoirs of Eleanor Coppola who, after being diagnosed with a rare cancer, reflects on her role as the matriarch of a renowned family of filmmakers and on the creative challenges she faced as an artist during the final years of her life.

The author honestly recounts her effort to balance her role as a wife and mother with her career as a writer and filmmaker, marked by works such as Notes: On the Making of Apocalypse Now and the documentary Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker’s Apocalypse. An emotional story about family, creation, and resilience in the face of artistic and personal difficulties.

Includes an introduction by Sofia Coppola and an afterword by Alice Waters.
